description: This file implements a serializer class SkipFieldCodec for skipping fields during serialization/deserialization and extension methods for skipping fields within a Reader, specifically for Orleans.Serialization infrastructure. It provides mechanisms to efficiently skip various wire types encountered in serialized data, supporting the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: SkipFieldCodec
classes.description: A serializer that skips all encountered fields during serialization/deserialization processes.

classes.name: SkipFieldExtension
classes.description: Contains extension methods for the Reader class to facilitate skipping fields based on wire types.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Method intended to write a field but currently throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value from the reader, skips the field, and returns null.

methods.name: SkipField
methods.description: Extension method that skips over a field based on its wire type, marking value fields and handling various wire types accordingly.

methods.name: ThrowUnexpectedExtendedWireType
methods.description: Throws an exception for an unexpected extended wire type encountered.

methods.name: ThrowUnexpectedWireType
methods.description: Throws an exception for an unexpected wire type encountered.

methods.name: SkipLengthPrefixedField
methods.description: Skips over a length-prefixed field using its length.

methods.name: SkipTagDelimitedField
methods.description: Skips over a tag-delimited field by reading headers until the end of the object.
